title: Kindly Baked Mediterranean Chickpeas Pilaf
description: A tender and comforting Mediterranean dish featuring chickpeas, perfect for a sick day. This cultured pilaf is made with air-fried chickpeas and is nut-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chickpeas with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Air-fry the chickpeas in a single layer at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes, shaking halfway through.
In a large saucepan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the saucepan and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste, dried oregano, and cooked chickpeas, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the basmati rice to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Cover the saucepan with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
